hook: SharePoint document libraries often turn into dumping grounds where files vanish and views lie. This episode shows SharePoint owners and Microsoft 365 admins how the new library UX, Forms, autofill columns and Copilot turn a file pile into a governed intake-to-publish pipeline that people actually use.
